A1.dimension: A1 — Recap & Coverage (whole-engagement prompt recap + the 8 live critiques mapped to the M plan)
A1.verdict:
COVERAGE SUMMARY. I recapped the engagement across MEMORY.md (tranches A–M lineage), project_tranche_{m,k,j}.md, the M plan corpus (M.md §0–§13, PROGRESS.md, M-AMENDMENT-latest-and-BB.md, M-design-language.md), the prior 32-agent audit index, and the live state (5 jpeg panes @1440 + 5 user crops). The recurring META-DIRECTIVE (deeply-audit / idiomatic-gestalt / fold-ALL-chronics / recap-ALL-prompts / NOT-implementation / no-legacy) is HONOURED by M at the planning layer and — crucially — M is explicitly framed as the EXECUTION tranche that resolves the "~6× planned-never-shipped" chronic by-construction (M.md §0). NEW THIS RUN: M.W1 was actually EXECUTED this session (the bump + the UnderlineTabs->SegmentedTabs/MetricBadge/glass-scrubber/DialogContent/glass-wash migration ran on branch m/w1-bump-migration). This is the FIRST tranche-M wave to physically run. The PROGRESS.md ledger still marks M.W1 `planned` — it does NOT reflect the executed migration (gamma residue finding F-RECAP-01).

THE 8-CRITIQUE DISPOSITION (each traced to the M plan):
(1) not-glassy cartoon cards -> ALREADY-COVERED by M.W5 (glass depth ladder + .cartoon-card DELETE). PARTIAL: the design doc maps error/loading cards to glass but the live toast/error card (crop 01, gallery toast) still renders cartoon — confirms W5 not yet run; no new gap.
(2) borders-not-rounded -> PARTIAL. M.W5 sweeps "raw radii -> --radius-*" (C2 incongruence) but the plan never states a frozen radius SYSTEM tied to the band ladder; new finding F-CRIT-02.
(3) no-desktop-tabs-for-visualizer -> the tabs ARE `lg:hidden` in source (VisualizationView.vue:181) so are mobile-only by design; the @1440 capture rendered the mobile branch (controls pinned RIGHT, dead dot-grid left). The REAL issue the critique exposes is the desktop layout (controls-RIGHT + dead stage), which is critique 4. New observation finding F-CRIT-03 (breakpoint/capture nuance + the desktop-layout root).
(4) ALL-controls-LEFT (DEC-2) -> ALREADY-COVERED, strongly, by M.W8 (asideSide="left" + delete the 3 grid-template-columns overrides). Confirmed: source still pins controls RIGHT (VisualizationView.vue:322). No new gap; reaffirm.
(5) dropdown/glass-DARKENED -> NEW / PARTIAL. The plan only books the dead `glass-elevated` on the coeff popover (C3-02) as a fourier adoption; it does NOT name a glass-ui 4.0 MENU/overlay surface darkening regression. The live nav dropdown (crop 08) is flat opaque grey on glass-ui 4.0. New glass-ui ask + finding F-CRIT-05 (alpha).
(6) buttons-invisible-unhovered -> PARTIAL. M.W8 names one-amber-per-pane + the DockIconButton-active ask + §3 accent-tone, but does NOT crisply address ghost/outline-button idle paint in DARK mode (the "Open the Visualizer" outline chip, the preset pills). New finding F-CRIT-06 (beta + possible glass-ui ask).
(7) tabs-should-be-GLASS -> NEW CONFLICT. M.W1 (and M.W8 prose) deliberately chose `variant="underline"` to match the retired UnderlineTabs; the user REVERSES this. This is the sharpest gamma residue. New finding F-CRIT-07.
(8) search-OFFSET-SQUARE -> NEW. The plan has no item on the input focus-ring. The live focus ring (crop 11) is a square blue outline offset beyond the rounded field. New glass-ui input focus-ring ask + finding F-CRIT-08 (alpha).

NET: 4 of 8 are already well-covered (1,3,4 + the proportion frame) and reaffirmed; 4 are NEW or materially under-covered (5,6,7,8) and one ROOT version mismatch threads them all — the user critiqued glass-ui 4.0.0 while the M amendment targets BB's 4.1.0 (F-RECAP-02). The recap/fold meta-directive is honoured; the M.W1-executed-but-PROGRESS-stale is the one bookkeeping breach.

The W5 sweep then maps radius alongside the rung in the same pass, not as a separate cleanup. Net: no new tokens invented, the glass-ui scale is the source.

A3.dimension: A3 — M.W1 bump+migration audit (correctness vs glass-ui 4.0 API + the residue ledger)
A3.verdict: The M.W1 migration is LANDED-BUT-INCOMPLETE and UNCOMMITTED (entire bump lives in the working tree, zero commits on m/w1-bump-migration vs master). The four headline mechanical renames are CORRECT against glass-ui 4.0: UnderlineTabs→SegmentedTabs, MetricBadge :amount→:value (0 :amount remain), DialogContent variant→surface (0 variant="opaque" remain), and the glass-ladder vocab swaps (0 glass-subtle/elevated/medium/quiet remain). BUT the migration is NOT green and NOT plan-complete on SEVEN counts: (1) the BB PEER-GATE is BREACHED — value.js@0.13.0 is INVALID against glass-ui 4.0.0's peer `^0.10.0 || ^0.11.0` (npm ls → ELSPROBLEMS); this only closes at glass-ui 4.1.0 (BB W-PEER-SPINE admits `^0.12.0 || ^0.13.0`), so the inv-27 green-CI gate CANNOT be cited today and `npm ci` may fail strict. (2) The glass-scrubber→standard variant swap landed but the `--slider-scrub-*` retint hooks were NOT remapped to the 4.0 knobs (`--slider-range-bg`/`--slider-track-bg`) in all 7 files — they are now DEAD CSS (inv-3 legacy breach); this was the one non-mechanical step the plan flagged (§6.3.2) and it was skipped. (3) CanvasOverlayButton.vue was NOT deleted (plan STEP 2i). (4) useClipboard (3 sites) was NOT moved to /dom and Collapsible was NOT moved to /collapsible (plan 2f/2g). (5) The Node-20 Actions cutover was NOT done — ci.yml + deploy-pages.yml still pin checkout@v4/setup-node@v4 (plan STEP 3). (6) Four peer packages (vaul-vue, embla-carousel-vue, perfect-freehand, @lucide/vue) are present in node_modules but ABSENT from package.json (the --no-save install) → non-reproducible CI install. (7) The variant="underline" tab choice is now REVERSED by user critique #7 (wants glass/pill). The cartoon-card shim survives at 25 sites + its style.css @utility definition (a self-described "dead-class resurrection"). The latex-paper/theme TS2882 is pre-existing CSS-side-effect noise (present on master, exit 0) — NOT bump-induced, out of scope.

findings.title: Two lucide packages coexist: app uses lucide-vue-next ^1.0.0 while glass-ui 4.0 peers @lucide/vue ^1.16.0 — duplicate icon libraries shipped

findings.current_state: fourier's application code imports icons from lucide-vue-next (the legacy package name); glass-ui 4.0 internally consumes @lucide/vue (the renamed package). Both ship. This doubles the icon-library footprint in the bundle and risks tree-shaking duplication. lucide-vue-next ^1.0.0 also lags the @lucide/vue ^1.16.0 glass-ui expects — version skew between the two icon sets.

Single icon library, shared with glass-ui, no bundle duplication. The icon component names are stable across the rename (verify the few used: Undo2, ChevronDown, Search, X, RotateCcw, Layers, Trash2, Crown, Download, Wand2, ChevronRight, RefreshCw, ArrowRight, Minimize2, Maximize2, ChevronUp). findings.title: .cartoon-card shim (25 sites + @utility definition in style.css) survives — a self-described 'dead-class resurrection' that is the root of critique #1 (cartoon-stamp, not glassy)

findings.current_state: The .cartoon-card @utility re-binds a class glass-ui deleted at C.W5, applying a 2px border + offset-stamp shadow + opaque var(--card) fill. It is explicitly self-documented as a 'dead-class resurrection' / 'KISS stop-gap' — a no-legacy violation under inv-3, and the antithesis of the glass ladder.
findings.proposed: Retire the .cartoon-card @utility and shim entirely; transpose all 25 sites onto the glass-ui 4.0 depth ladder (.glass-wash/-quiet/-resting/-floating from styles/glass/ladder.css) chosen per surface register (document cards → glass-wash/quiet; floating panels/modals → glass-floating; overlays → glass-overlay). Drop the offset-stamp shadow and opaque fill in favour of the translucent ladder + proper --radius tokens. This is the M.W5 glass-depth adoption (β) and directly answers critiques #1 (glassy) and #2 (rounded). The shim deletion is the no-legacy close. Map each of the 14 files to a ladder rung in the M.W5 design spec.
